summary: The Voidscar Wastes are the most corrupted region of the Riftlands, where breaches into the cosmic Void tear through Discord’s frontier. Terrain collapses into nothingness, Void winds scour the land, and Voidborn entities roam freely.
history: Void breaches first opened when Discord-Core’s instability reached the outer frontier.
Entire sections of terrain were erased, leaving Nullwind Dunes and Erasure Basins.
Voidborn entities crossed into Discord, feeding on corruption and dimensional collapse.
Riftseekers attempted containment but could not stabilize the largest breaches.
The Voidborn Citadel formed as a nexus of Void energy and Discord corruption.
